77166.commentary: (THIa) nhāpan'ucchādanehi cā'ti sambāhan'ādīni kāretvā nhāpanena ucchādanena ca.

examples.text: vibhūsāmaṇḍanaratā, nhāpan'ucchādanehi ca, upakāsiṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ, kāmarāgena aṭṭitā.

77167.commentary: (THIa) tato saddhaṃ labhitvānā'ti evaṃ samādinnavatāni bhinditvā kāyadaḷhībahulā vādappasutā hutvā tattha tattha vicarantī tato pacchā aparabhāge mahāmoggallānattherassa santike laddh'ovād'ānusāsanā saddhaṃ paṭilabhitvā.

examples.text: tato saddhaṃ labhitvāna, pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ, disvā kāyaṃ yathābhūtaṃ, kāmarāgo samūhato.

77168.meaning1: zealously desiring gain and honour; anxiously striving for acquisitions and esteem
77168.commentary: (THIa) vicariṃ'haṃ tena tena, lābhasakkāraussukā'ti lābhe ca sakkāre ca ussukā yuttappayuttā hutvā tena tena bāhusaccadhammakath'ādinā lābh'uppādahetunā vicariṃ ahaṃ.

examples.text: saddhāya pabbajitvāna, agārasm'ānagāriyaṃ, vicariṃ'haṃ tena tena, lābhasakkāraussukā.

77169.commentary: (THIa) hīnam'atthaṃ asevi'han'ti catupaccaya-saṅkhāta-āmisa-bhāvato hīnaṃ lāmakaṃ atthaṃ ayoniso pariyesanāya paṭiseviṃ ahaṃ.

examples.text: riñcitvā paramaṃ atthaṃ, hīnam'atthaṃ asevi'haṃ, kilesānaṃ vasaṃ gantvā, sāmaññ'atthaṃ na bujjhihaṃ.

77170.commentary: (THIa) nisinnāya vihārake'ti mama vasanakaovarake nisinnāya ahu saṃvego.

examples.text: tassā me ahu saṃvego, nisinnāya vihārake, ummaggapaṭipann'āmhi, taṇhāya vasam'āgatā.

77171.meaning1: following the wrong road; going the wrong way; getting sidetracked
77171.commentary: (THIa) ummaggapaṭipannāmhī'ti yāva'd'eva anupādāya parinibbān'attham'idaṃ sāsanaṃ, tattha sāsane pabbajitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ amanasikarontī tassa ummaggapaṭipannā amhī'ti.

examples.text: tassā me ahu saṃvego, nisinnāya vihārake, ummaggapaṭipann'āmhi, taṇhāya vasam'āgatā.

77172.meaning1: under the power (of); under the influence (of); controlled (by)
77172.commentary: (THIa) taṇhāya vasam'āgatā'ti paccay'uppādanataṇhāya vasaṃ upagatā. (JAa) anatthavasam'āgatan'ti tāya khiḍḍāratiyā kāmakīḷāya anatthakārakānaṃ kilesānaṃ vasaṃ āgataṃ maṃ viditvā.

examples.text: tassā me ahu saṃvego, nisinnāya vihārake, ummaggapaṭipann'āmhi, taṇhāya vasam'āgatā.

77176.meaning1: born from conditions; arisen from causes

examples.text: saṅkhāre parato disvā, hetujāte palokite, pahāsiṃ āsave sabbe, sītibhūt'āmhi nibbutā'ti.

77177.meaning1: accumulation of matter; pile of material; (comm) accumulation called form

examples.text: dasa putte vijāyitvā, asmiṃ rūpasamussaye, tato'haṃ dubbalā jiṇṇā, bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamiṃ.

77178.meaning1: having immediate release; with liberation immediately afterwards
77178.commentary: (THIa) anantarāvimokkh'āsin'ti aggamaggassa anantarā uppannavimokkhā āsiṃ. rūpī rūpāni passatī'tiādayo hi aṭṭha'pi vimokkhā anantaravimokkhā nāma na honti. magg'ānantaraṃ anuppattā hi phalavimokkhā phalasamāpattikāle pavattamānā'pi paṭhamamagg'ānantaram'eva samuppattito taṃ upādāya anantaravimokkhā nāma, yathā maggasamādhi ānantarikasamādhī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: animittañ'ca bhāvemi, ek'aggā susamāhitā, anantarāvimokkh'āsiṃ, anupādāya nibbutā.

77179.meaning1: with shaved head; (comm) with plucked out hair
77179.commentary: (THIa) lūnakesī'ti lūnā luñcitā kesā mayhan'ti lūnakesī, nigaṇṭhesu pabbajjāya tāl'aṭṭhinā luñcitakesā, taṃ sandhāya vadati.

examples.text: lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.

yato kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā sannidhikārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ. atha kaṇo'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, thuso'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, lūnam'pi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ, apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo aṭṭhaṃsu.

77181.meaning1: covered in mud; (comm) with unbrushed teeth

examples.text: lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.

77186.meaning1: female ascetic who wears one robe; ascetic dressed in a single cloth

examples.text: naṅgalehi kasaṃ khettaṃ, bījāni pavapaṃ chamā, puttadārāni posentā, dhanaṃ vindanti māṇavā.

77188.meaning1: following the teacher's instruction; complying with the master's teaching

examples.text: kim'ahaṃ sīlasampannā, satthusāsanakārikā, nibbānaṃ n'ādhigacchāmi, akusītā anuddhatā.

77189.commentary: (THIa) pāde pakkhālayitvānā'tiādi. tass'attho, ahaṃ pāde dhovantī pādapakkhālanahetu tikkhattuṃ āsittesu udakesu thalato ninnam'āgataṃ pād'odakaṃ disvā nimittaṃ karomi.

examples.text: pāde pakkhālayitvāna, udakesu karom'ahaṃ, pād'odakañ'ca disvāna, thalato ninnam'āgataṃ.

77191.commentary: (THIa) tass'attho, ahaṃ pāde dhovantī pādapakkhālanahetu tikkhattuṃ āsittesu udakesu thalato ninnam'āgataṃ pād'odakaṃ disvā nimittaṃ karomi.

examples.text: pāde pakkhālayitvāna, udakesu karom'ahaṃ, pād'odakañ'ca disvāna, thalato ninnam'āgataṃ.

77192.meaning1: having looked at; having checked; having inspected

examples.text: tato cittaṃ samādhesiṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va'jāniyaṃ, tato dīpaṃ gahetvāna, vihāraṃ pāvisiṃ ahaṃ, seyyaṃ olokayitvāna, mañcakamhi upāvisiṃ.

77194.commentary: (THIa) vaṭṭiṃ okassayāmī'ti dīpaṃ vijjhāpetuṃ tel'ābhimukhaṃ dīpavaṭṭiṃ ākaḍḍhemi.

examples.text: tato sūciṃ gahetvāna, vaṭṭiṃ okassayām'ahaṃ, padīpass'eva nibbānaṃ, vimokkho ahu cetaso'ti.
musalāni gahetvāna, dhaññaṃ koṭṭenti māṇavā, puttadārāni posentā, dhanaṃ vindanti māṇavā.

77197.commentary: (THIa) bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigan'ti bhattassa coḷassa ca pāripūriṃ n'ādhigacchiṃ, kevalaṃ pana bhikkhāpiṇḍassa pilotikākhaṇḍassa ca vasena ghāsacchādanamattam'eva alatthan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: duggat'āhaṃ pure āsiṃ, vidhavā ca aputtikā, vinā mittehi ñātīhi, bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigaṃ.

77198.grammar: imperf of na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
77198.meaning1: did not obtain; did not get; did not acquire
77198.commentary: (THIa) bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigan'ti bhattassa coḷassa ca pāripūriṃ n'ādhigacchiṃ, kevalaṃ pana bhikkhāpiṇḍassa pilotikākhaṇḍassa ca vasena ghāsacchādanamattam'eva alatthan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: duggat'āhaṃ pure āsiṃ, vidhavā ca aputtikā, vinā mittehi ñātīhi, bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigaṃ.

77199.commentary: (THIa) sītuṇhena ca ḍayhantī'ti vasanageh'ābhāvato sītena ca uṇhena ca pīḷiyamānā.

examples.text: pattaṃ daṇḍañ'ca gaṇhitvā, bhikkhamānā kulā kulaṃ, sīt'uṇhena ca ḍayhantī, satta vassāni cāri'haṃ.
